chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"There is no objection to performing the independent Umrah during the months of Hajj, then he returns to his family."

key_terms.أَشْهُرِ الْحَجِّ: Months of Hajj (Dhu al-Qi'dah, Dhu al-Hijjah, and the first ten days of Muharram)
key_terms.الْعُمْرَةِ الْمُفْرَدَةِ: Independent Umrah (Umrah performed separately from Hajj)
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: There is no objection / It is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform Umrah separately from Hajj during the months of Hajj?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the permissibility of performing Umrah al-Mufradah (independent Umrah) during the Hajj months, allowing the pilgrim to conclude the rites and return home without remaining in Ihram for Hajj. This ruling highlights the flexibility in Shia jurisprudence regarding the distinction between Umrah and Hajj, contrasting with views that might emphasize combining them during these specific months. It underscores the principle that Umrah is a distinct act of worship with its own completion criteria, independent of the Hajj season's duration.
